rules: event_id is immutable and unique within the event store.
correlation_id links events in one end-to-end transaction/case flow.
causation_id references the immediate causal event when available; null is allowed when no prior event is emitted.
scope=cross_bank requires server-side authorization, explicit legal purpose and authorized exchange agreement.
Synthetic events must set data_mode=synthetic and must not trigger real bank actions.
payload is validated against the object/event contract.
Legacy aliases such as audit_id and details may coexist during migration but are not canonical identifiers.
